conclusion: After the host console was unlocked, the isolated qualifier restored the retained saved state in a new process, reached the post-restore window state, consumed the prior saved-state artifact, then exited cleanly after AppKit termination and wrote a fresh Apple saved-state receipt. The earlier -25308 Secure Enclave/interaction denial did not repeat. This closes the locked-console diagnosis for the qualifier path, while release-daemon MachineManager Mac lifecycle qualification remains separate.
